chains.name: McDonald's
chains.src: mcdonalds.com (US) item nutrition, every size McDonald's lists for an item (12 Nov 2026). Allergens are the ones McDonald's lists for each part of the item. Single pieces (1 wing, 1 nugget and so on) are the published pack divided by its count.

chains.name: Chick-fil-A
chains.src: Chick-fil-A Nutrition & Allergens (20 Nov 2026). Salads are as Chick-fil-A lists them for each protein. Chick-fil-A cooks in refined peanut oil, which the FDA doesn't count as an allergen, so its table doesn't list it. Single pieces (1 wing, 1 nugget and so on) are the published pack divided by its count.

chains.name: Wendy's
chains.src: Wendy's US online menu, national (no store chosen) (12 Nov 2026). The national menu shows one size: Jr. fries and Frosty, small drinks. Full-sugar fountain drinks are left out because that menu lists them at 0 Cal. Salads come without and with their dressing packet, which Wendy's lists on its own. Single pieces (1 wing, 1 nugget and so on) are the published pack divided by its count.

chains.name: Taco Bell
chains.src: tacobell.com item pages and the Nutritionix label each one links under Nutrition Info, every drink size (26 Nov 2026). Rounded the way Taco Bell's label rounds them (FDA rules) Single pieces (1 wing, 1 nugget and so on) are the published pack divided by its count.

chains.name: Panda Express
chains.src: Panda Express Nutrition & Allergen Information (13 Nov 2026). Sides and entrées are listed on their own, as Panda does; a bowl is one side and one entrée. Drinks are by cup size in fl oz

chains.name: Burger King
chains.src: Burger King Nutrition Explorer (14 Nov 2026), each item as served with its standard toppings. Allergens are the ones Burger King lists as contained; may-contain includes shared cooking equipment. Single pieces (1 wing, 1 nugget and so on) are the published pack divided by its count.

chains.name: Popeyes
chains.src: Popeyes USA Nutrition Guide (November 2026, checked 14 Nov 2026). Classic and spicy chicken share one row, as Popeyes lists them. No allergens yet: they're in a separate chart. Single pieces (1 wing, 1 nugget and so on) are the published pack divided by its count.

chains.name: Arby's
chains.src: Arby's Nutrition & Allergen Information (U.S.), NOV 2026 edition. Allergens are the guide's Contains / May contain lists; items marked as made in a facility that handles peanuts or tree nuts have those as may-contain, and fried sides cooked in shared oil have the oil's allergens as may-contain, and milk from the buttered buns a few markets use is may-contain. Drinks are with 50% ice fill. Left out: bottled water and items the guide repeats in the Kids and Value menus; 1 row(s) whose calories don't match their macros (Mello Yello (medium)). (22 Nov 2026) Single pieces (1 wing, 1 nugget and so on) are the published pack divided by its count.

chains.name: Five Guys
chains.src: Five Guys Nutrition & Allergen Guide, USA, September 2026 edition. Burgers and dogs are built to order, so the guide lists their parts (patties, buns, each topping); Hamburger, Little Hamburger and Hot Dog here are the sums of their published parts with no toppings. Where a part comes from two suppliers the first listed is kept. "<1" is saved as 0.5. Fries are cooked in refined peanut oil, which the guide doesn't count as a peanut allergen. Left out: a second "Mini Five Guys Style" fries row in the guide's Cajun group (its label doesn't say which fries it is). (22 Nov 2026) Single pieces (1 wing, 1 nugget and so on) are the published pack divided by its count.

chains.name: Del Taco
chains.src: Del Taco Menu Items Nutritional List and Allergen List (September 2026). Allergens and Vegetarian/Vegan are the Allergen List's marks, matched to each item by name. Left out: meals (calorie ranges only), the chicken & fries box and bottled water; 3 item(s) not on the Allergen List have no allergens (Flamin' Hot Queso Loaded Fries (Carne Asada Steak), Minute Maid Zero Sugar Lemonade Dirty Del (large), Minute Maid Zero Sugar Lemonade Dirty Del (regular)). (22 Nov 2026) Single pieces (1 wing, 1 nugget and so on) are the published pack divided by its count.

chains.name: El Pollo Loco
chains.src: El Pollo Loco Nutrition Guide (M5 2026 edition). Allergens are the guide's X marks. Drinks are without ice. Salads are without dressing (dressings are listed on their own). Left out: meals with sides, bottled water, and the Combos and Kids Meals sections, which repeat entrées listed elsewhere; 1 row(s) whose calories don't match their macros (BBQ Black Beans (small)). (22 Nov 2026) Single pieces (1 wing, 1 nugget and so on) are the published pack divided by its count.

chains.name: Jack in the Box
chains.src: Jack in the Box Nutrition Facts poster (effective November 2026). Allergens are the poster's letters (the nine US majors, sesame included). The poster's text layer is imperfect, so rows were checked against each other and against their macros; left out: 3 unreadable, 4 meal or other, 2 repeated figures row(s), bottled water and Munchie Meal-only sizes. (22 Nov 2026) Single pieces (1 wing, 1 nugget and so on) are the published pack divided by its count.

chains.name: In-N-Out Burger
chains.src: In-N-Out Burger Nutrition Facts (PDF), January 2026 edition. Fountain drinks are the with-ice figures for each cup; the guide gives the drinks' missing figures (saturated fat, fibre) as 0. No allergens: the guide points to in-n-out.com/nutrition for those. Left out: the without-ice drink figures. (26 Nov 2026)

chains.name: Hardee's
chains.how: Official nutrition poster (image, read with OCR)
chains.src: Hardee's Nutritional Information poster (U.S.), 2025 edition, read from the poster image with OCR. Allergens are the poster's letters (the nine US majors, sesame included); '+' (ice cream made where peanuts or tree nuts are present) is may-contain peanut and tree nut. Cells the OCR skipped (mostly zeros) are read glyph by glyph from character shapes learnt from the rest of the poster. Left out: kids' meals and bottled water; 1 row(s) whose calories don't match their macros (5-Piece Spicy Hand-Breaded Chicken Tenders). (26 Nov 2026) Single pieces (1 wing, 1 nugget and so on) are the published pack divided by its count.

chains.name: Carl's Jr.
chains.how: Official nutrition poster (image, read with OCR)
chains.src: Carl's Jr. Nutritional Information poster (U.S.), dated 4/2/2026 (month/day/year), read from the poster image with OCR. Allergens are the poster's letters (the nine US majors, sesame included); '+' (ice cream made where peanuts or tree nuts are present) is may-contain peanut and tree nut. Cells the OCR skipped (mostly zeros) are read glyph by glyph from character shapes learnt from the rest of the poster. Left out: kids' meals and bottled water; sodium left out where it can't be right next to the other cup sizes: Diet Dr Pepper (32 oz) (1184 mg). (26 Nov 2026) Single pieces (1 wing, 1 nugget and so on) are the published pack divided by its count.

chains.name: Chipotle
chains.src: Chipotle US Nutrition Facts (paper menu PDF linked from chipotle.com's nutrition calculator, file dated 3/2025; chart codes OCT-2024-US-CK, OCT-2024-US-PPS). Chipotle publishes figures per ingredient, not per burrito or bowl, so ingredients are extras at Chipotle's standard portions; drinks come from both the Coca-Cola and Pepsi charts. No allergens in the PDF. Left out: the Kid's Menu portions and the calorie-only menu board; 2 row(s) whose calories don't match their macros (Maine Root Root Beer (22 fl oz), Maine Root Root Beer (32 fl oz)). (26 Nov 2026)

chains.name: Jimmy John's
chains.how: Official nutrition and allergen guide (Nutritionix data)
chains.src: Jimmy John's Nutrition & Allergen Guide (US), the Nutritionix-hosted guide jimmyjohns.com links, menu last updated 2026-11-18. Figures are the guide's per-item values with FDA label rounding; allergens are its Contains flags for the nine US majors (no may-contain list is published). Left out: Preview items, fountain and bottled drinks (no figures) and items in no menu category; 1 row(s) whose calories don't match their macros (Jimmy Pickle). (26 Nov 2026)

chains.name: Firehouse Subs
chains.src: Firehouse Subs Interactive Nutrition Menu (US), from the Nutritionix-hosted Nutrition Portal firehousesubs.com links, last updated 2026-09-09. Figures are as published (FDA rounding). No allergens: the portal gives no per-item allergen list. Left out: catering, boxed lunches, Kid's Subs and kids' drinks, the per-size sub-builder ingredient rows, the 12 oz cup, Freestyle flavour-shot drinks and flavoured waters. (26 Nov 2026)

chains.name: Krispy Kreme
chains.src: Krispy Kreme per-item Nutritional & Allergen Info sheets (US), linked from each product page on krispykreme.com/menu, revised 9 Dec 2025 to 5 Aug 2026. Drinks are as published (lattes with 2% milk unless the name says oat milk). Allergens left out: the sheets cover only peanuts, tree nuts, soy, milk, eggs and wheat. Left out: 24 Count Original Glazed® Doughnut Dots, 24 Count Assorted Doughnut Dots, Original Glazed® Latte (links the Original Glazed Flavored Iced Coffee sheet), Espresso, Krispy Kreme Classic K-Cup, Krispy Kreme Classic Decaf K-Cup, Classic Ground Coffee, Classic Decaf Ground Coffee, Iced Caramel Mocha Coffee (links the Iced Caramel Mocha Latte sheet), Strawberry Chiller, Classic Brewed Coffee Box, Classic Decaf Brewed Coffee Box. (26 Nov 2026) Single pieces (1 wing, 1 nugget and so on) are the published pack divided by its count.

chains.name: Jack's
chains.src: Jack's Family Restaurants product pages (eatatjacks.com, undated; read on the date checked): calories, fat, carbs and protein only, so saturated fat, sugar, fibre and sodium are null. Allergens left out: the site's icons don't cover fish, shellfish or peanuts separately. Left out: meals, combos, boxes, bundles and deals (22 pages, incl. bottled water and pages without figures) and items given only as a calorie range (Fountain Drinks (20oz or 32oz), Freshly Brewed Lemonade, Freshly Brewed Tea, Ice Cream Scoops, Iced Coffee, Milkshakes, Fried Pies). (26 Nov 2026) Single pieces (1 wing, 1 nugget and so on) are the published pack divided by its count.
